problem_text:
A manufacturing network seeks to devise a quality‑improvement strategy to lower total defect rates across several production lines. Initially, no corrective procedures have been implemented.  

The characteristics of each production line are as follows:  
* For Line 1, defect coefficient is 1.746, output volume is 291.672.  
* For Line 2, defect coefficient is 1.787, output volume is 103.786.  
* For Line 3, defect coefficient is 1.747, output volume is 138.224.  
* For Line 4, defect coefficient is 1.271, output volume is 62.635.  
* For Line 5, defect coefficient is 0.558, output volume is 173.724.  
* For Line 6, defect coefficient is 2.863, output volume is 270.585.  
* For Line 7, defect coefficient is 1.764, output volume is 213.565.  

To reduce defects, several corrective protocols are available, each with a specific effectiveness rate:  
* Protocol 1 lowers the defect rate by 52%  
* Protocol 2 lowers the defect rate by 47%  
* Protocol 3 lowers the defect rate by 22%  
* Protocol 4 lowers the defect rate by 55%  
* Protocol 5 lowers the defect rate by 19%  
* Protocol 6 lowers the defect rate by 32%  
* Protocol 7 lowers the defect rate by 29%  

Implementing a protocol on a line incurs an extra cost per unit of output. The cost matrix for all line–protocol combinations is given below:  

| Line \ Protocol | Protocol 1 | Protocol 2 | Protocol 3 | Protocol 4 | Protocol 5 | Protocol 6 | Protocol 7 |  
|----------------|------------|------------|------------|------------|------------|------------|------------|  
| Line 1         | 79.528     | 86.111     | 118.354    | 46.985     | 115.112    | 23.971     | 105.809    |  
| Line 2         | 155.237    | 63.147     | 197.927    | 139.276    | 32.574     | 195.266    | 84.842     |  
| Line 3         | 161.03     | 74.426     | 188.4      | 153.443    | 47.821     | 106.733    | 105.015    |  
| Line 4         | 18.608     | 36.037     | 73.278     | 100.011    | 96.828     | 125.189    | 107.946    |  
| Line 5         | 72.314     | 126.483    | 40.875     | 198.217    | 150.471    | 66.855     | 73.911     |  
| Line 6         | 167.375    | 111.145    | 144.661    | 66.96      | 164.992    | 79.988     | 138.023    |  
| Line 7         | 196.181    | 120.903    | 161.383    | 147.812    | 140.728    | 15.063     | 100.172    |  

Management must decide which protocols to apply to each line (a line may adopt several protocols concurrently), and a line may also remain partially untreated if needed. The objective is to guarantee that the overall defect quantity is reduced by at least a fraction P = 0.684 of the original defect level, while minimizing the total implementation cost.
